breaking_changes.BC_description: The methods uuid.parse() and uuid.unparse() have been removed in version 3.0.0. These methods previously allowed conversions between UUID strings and buffers. As a result, any calls to uuid.parse() or uuid.unparse() will now cause runtime errors, and parsing/un-parsing functionality must be replaced with custom code or a different library such as 'uuid-parse'.
Reference: GitHub issue/PR: Parse/unparse methods removed in v3??
